items.title: When should an air sensor be checked again?
items.assessment: Public research-compatible data, small CPU workload and a substantive adaptive-learning comparison. LTU connection is a measurement/efficient-ML methods fit, not a currently advertised air-sensor thesis.
items.correction: Removed an unsupported causal claim about separating sensor drift from environmental change. The contribution is a matched-budget sequential comparison, not the invention of reference-efficient calibration.

items.title: Tell mosquito species apart without learning the recording site
items.assessment: Failed actual-data access gate; prior work also removes the original generic adaptation claim.

items.title: Show where a small flood mapper is unsure about the shoreline
items.assessment: Failed licence gate despite successful sample downloads.

items.title: Leave room for appliances the energy model has never seen
items.assessment: Metadata openness did not translate into verified usable data.

items.title: Tell a water engineer when several leak locations look equally plausible
items.assessment: Usable licensed simulation inputs, but narrower LTU research connection and incomplete closest-paper access make this a reserve study, not a top recommendation.
items.correction: Unseen-location evaluation requires shared node-wise scoring or scenario inference. Fixed multiclass trees are restricted to held-out episodes at known locations.

items.title: Stop sleep-stage smoothing from erasing short real changes
items.assessment: Data and CPU path pass, but exact scope should be tightened against very close existing work; LTU brain-signal methods fit is adjacent rather than an advertised sleep project.

items.title: Should an ECG model fill missing signals or work with what it has?
items.assessment: Verified public signal/label access and an achievable, substantive applied model-development/evaluation study. Rank below the directly LTU-linked voice/inner-speech directions for institutional specificity.
items.correction: Missing recorded lead channels are distinct from physical electrode failures; the example and simulated-missingness claim now preserve that distinction.

items.title: Let a small earthquake detector admit when its timing is unreliable
items.assessment: Data and CPU study are credible, but institutional/application fit is weaker than the directly linked LTU ML topics. Keep as reserve; do not promote based only on the word geophysics.

items.title: Teach a small voice-command model which similar words to ignore
items.assessment: Directly connected to LTU’s explicitly listed speech/audio master-thesis interests, verified public audio and a months-long scientific comparison. No new architecture is required.

items.title: Can a brain-signal model get the right answer for the wrong reason?
items.assessment: Strongest direct LTU project/data connection, with real licensed file access. Promising thesis direction once the explicit alignment/control pilot is resolved; not a ready semantic-decoding claim.
items.correction: Visible words prevent isolated inner-speech identification. The study is a cued-task classification/artifact audit; no causal fraction of thought decoding is claimed.

items.title: Teach a small model when an empty form field is for a signature
items.assessment: Direct current LTU research connection, public permitted image/annotation pair decoded, and a substantive CPU-sized model-training design. Feasibility is prospective: runtime and grouping/mask-encoding pilots remain, as in any unstarted thesis.
items.correction: Natural held-out signature prevalence must be preserved; only training negatives may be capped or resampled.

items.title: Keep marginal notes separate when manuscript training labels are rough
items.assessment: Direct current LTU research connection, public permitted image/annotation pair decoded, and a substantive CPU-sized model-training design. Feasibility is prospective: runtime and grouping/mask-encoding pilots remain, as in any unstarted thesis.
items.correction: Boundary uncertainty and plausible class sets must be computed from coarsened training labels only. Clean masks cannot silently provide privileged training supervision.
